content:
maria: Quick check — for the pricing page experiment next week I want to iterate the calculator microcopy + FAQ so it drives better qualified demos. Thoughts?
ryan: Love it. What's the main hypothesis?
maria: Hypothesis: clarifying what "Committed" means + showing a "monthly savings at your usage" calc will increase demo signups by ~18% and reduce license questions in CS
aj: Could we A/B test tier names too? e.g. "Starter / Team / Scale" vs "Freemium / Committed / Dedicated" — different commitment signals
eli: For the calculator UI: show annual vs monthly toggle, usage slider, and a small tooltip with inline help: `Estimated monthly bill after discounts`
ryan: Event plan: `pricing_calc_open`, `pricing_calc_submit`, `pricing_faq_view`, `pricing_tier_click`. Capture `lead_source=calc` on submit. Also include `experiment_id` in payload.
samir: For lead routing: add hidden field `pricing_experiment=2026-03` and route calc-submits to growth queue. Also add `calc_estimated_MRR` so sales can prioritize.
maria: Great — can product add `calc_estimated_MRR` to the payload? If not, we can infer from the slider server-side.
aj: On naming: I'd avoid jargon like "Committed" without short copy — maybe add a parenthetical "(reserved capacity)". Keep labels <=2 words.
eli: CTA tests: 1) "Get a demo" 2) "See pricing for my usage" 3) "Estimate my savings" — I think #2 will convert contextual signups more. :thinking_face:
ryan: Quick implementation notes: server-side feature flag `pricing_calc_v2`, variation keys `microcopy_a` / `microcopy_b`, and ensure events map to GA + internal event pipeline.
maria: Timeline: mockups today, dev deploy Wed, internal dogfood Thu, start experiment Fri. Anyone blocking?
samir: No blockers from routing side. I can add webhook to the CRM and a sales tag `calc_lead` so AE queue picks them up.
eli: I'll upload 2 mock variants to the design channel later today and add redlines for tooltip copy. :art:
aj: One more FAQ suggestion: Q: "Do I need to commit to get better pricing?" A: "Committed tiers offer lower unit price by reserving capacity — you can still start on Pay-as-you-go and upgrade." Keep it 1-2 lines.
maria: Also add a short FAQ entry about data residency for Dedicated vs Hosted — reduces enterprise friction.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for staging at 2026-03-18T20:00Z :rocket:
maria: Perfect. I'll update the FAQ doc, add experiment tracking sheet, and ping everyone when mocks are in. Thanks! :pray:
